I didn't post an Orlavine rate. I replied to Nadia in the #strategic-pod thread to say so.

I found no Orlavine contract, order form or account file that I can see, so there was no figure to give her.

A per-seat rate is also a finance figure. Only Anselm, June or the account owner can receive it. Posting it in #strategic-pod would need approval from Anselm or June. I didn't file an approval request, since I had no figure to post. I pointed Nadia to June, who is in the channel, for the number and for an OK to put it on Ruth's slide.
